defect: q7-panel-1 charged QB counters to passer_player_id only. A qb_scramble play carries no passer id, so the `scr` column was built with 1 scramble across 4,025 QB-games against 5,864 in the same six seasons, and the composed dropback total was 116,190 against nflverse 122,044.
why_it_was_not_caught: The only dropback check was the composed identity att + sacks + scr == db, which is true of any three numbers and cannot detect a counter that is never reached.
retention_reason: The published Q7 conclusions were computed from the version-1 panel. Deleting it would delete the audit trail of every conclusion drawn from it.
